title: Hellas, pourquoy (Jacotin?)
desc: Jacotin (doubtful attribution), Hellas, pourquoy. 3 voices (Superius, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: La Couronne. No text in this edition. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; coloured notes stand for the triplet groups; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
